resources.string: New versions of SIOS without a cable, and back to the previous one by itself if something goes wrong.
Looking for a new version for this phone…

No answer from the update channel (%1$s).
The update isn\'t signed by SIOS, so nothing will be installed.
Waits for a network without a data limit.
It carries on in the background, even if you close this screen.
Paused. It will carry on from where it left off.
It goes into the other system slot, so you can keep using your phone. Nothing changes until you restart.
Restart whenever you like: it takes as long as a normal restart. If the new version doesn\'t start properly, your phone goes back to the one you have now by itself.
Waiting for the system to finish starting…
Unlock your phone to finish the check.
Waiting for the agent to come back…
Until everything checks out, the previous version stays saved in the other slot.
Going back to the previous version

The new version started properly and it\'s here to stay.

This phone is updated with a cable
It doesn\'t have two system slots (A/B), so there\'s nowhere to install the new version while you use it. Install new versions with SIOS Desktop.
Its slots aren\'t virtual A/B: installing only the system would leave the other slot without the rest of its firmware. Install new versions with SIOS Desktop.
This SIOS image doesn\'t have the system update key. Install the new version once with a cable (SIOS Desktop); after that it will update by itself.
Every update is signed: your phone checks the signature and the SHA-256 fingerprint before installing anything.
